body:
Source: GitHub issue #673 (bug, false-green, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 42cb00eb: packages/lesson-foundry/lib/foundry.mjs:66, bin/lesson-foundry.mjs. In `loadFindings`, unparseable and malformed ledger lines are dropped from findings and reported in `skipped`, but the downstream `--gate` check evaluates purely on surviving clusters. A corrupted or partially unparseable ledger silently drops lessons out of the denominator and exits 0 'clean'.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/lesson-foundry`: `bin/lesson-foundry.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/foundry.mjs` (loadFindings, findUnbankedClusters), `lib/report.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/lesson-foundry/bin/lesson-foundry.mjs`: when `--gate` is requested, if `skipped > 0` and `--tolerate-malformed` is not provided (or `skipped > Number(values['tolerate-malformed'] ?? 0)`), fail the gate (exit 2) or error with `findings ledger contains ${skipped} malformed line(s)`.
2. Add `--tolerate-malformed <n>` CLI option to permit explicit legacy tolerance when needed.
3. In `--json` mode, ensure `skipped` malformed count is surfaced and triggers gate failure in gate verdict.
4. Documentation: update `packages/lesson-foundry/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/lesson-foundry.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/lesson-foundry.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `lesson-foundry --gate` fails with exit 2 when findings ledger contains unparseable lines. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/malformed-ledger-gate.test.mjs`
- AC2 `lesson-foundry --gate --tolerate-malformed 2` succeeds when skipped count is <= threshold. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/malformed-ledger-gate.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "tolerate-malformed" packages/lesson-foundry/README.md docs/tools/lesson-foundry.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/lesson-foundry.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #671 (missing ledger opError) or #672 (empty defense file).
title: lesson-foundry: fail gate when findings ledger contains unparseable or malformed lines
